rounds.text: After the Wheel's turning point comes real responsibility. Justice holds up a mirror, an honest, unflinching reflection of what's true. Its rules aren't written in books, they come from an inner sense of care toward the world. Libra, ruled by Venus just like the Empress, brings its aesthetic, {b2}-seeking gaze to this card, so {b1} and equanimity become inseparable from what's fair.
